title: Open-cancer-data & licensing/identifiability gate + DATASET-CATALOG.md
context: Before any worked example can be authored, a binding licensing and identifiability gate must be in place to prevent non-open or identifiable patient data from reaching learners. The gate formalizes ALLOW/FLAG/DENY rules for cancer data sources and creates a CI-enforced catalog so the constraint is structural, not aspirational. COSMIC and OncoKB are explicitly flagged as non-commercial (excluded as example data); dbGaP, EGA, and all controlled-access or identifiable sources are categorically denied. This task is a blocking prerequisite for every task that touches a real cancer dataset (pilot-006, analysis-010, examples-015, capstone-016, workflows-022).
objective: Define and document the binding open-cancer-data & licensing/identifiability gate criteria, create DATASET-CATALOG.md with ALLOW/FLAG/DENY entries for all candidate sources, and produce a CI catalog validator that asserts every example references only a PASS-gate entry.
acceptanceCriteria: Encodes the binding guardrail: open-access/aggregate/de-identified data ONLY; dbGaP, EGA, controlled-access, individual-level, and identifiable patient data are categorically DENIED — rejected, not escalated.

Objective PASS criterion documented: license on the ALLOW list AND license.permitsDerivatives: true with cited clause/URL AND identifiability classified as none, aggregate, or deidentified. Missing evidence, non-commercial terms, controlled access, or any identifiability signal = FLAG/EXCLUDE.

DATASET-CATALOG.md created with ALLOW entries (GDC open tier, DepMap CC-BY 4.0, GEO/SRA per-series, cBioPortal public studies, ICGC open tier, Ensembl, gnomAD, synthetic/simulated), FLAG entries (COSMIC, OncoKB — non-commercial, excluded as example data sources), and DENY entries (dbGaP, EGA, controlled-access/identifiable).

Per-entry provenance requirements documented: source URL + version + retrieval date + license id/URL + committed snapshot (SHA-256 + Wayback URL) + identifiability classification + required attribution string.
CI catalog validator implemented: asserts every worked example references only a catalog entry with a committed PASS gate artifact and permitsDerivatives: true and non-identifiable classification.
A committed, reviewable PASS/FLAG/EXCLUDE artifact format defined; at least one example PASS artifact included for DepMap CC-BY 4.0.
Document and validator committed with DCO sign-off; reviewed and signed off by Data & licensing reviewer.
resources: DATASET-CATALOG.md (to be created by this task)
COSMIC license (non-commercial) — excluded as example data source
output: DATASET-CATALOG.md committed to the project repo with ALLOW/FLAG/DENY entries and per-entry gate artifacts; a CI catalog validator (TypeScript/ESM, MIT license) that gates every worked example against the catalog; and a documented gate procedure and provenance model.
